excerpt: The Proton Unlimited plan is a replacement for our previous bundles that combined Proton Mail Plus and Proton VPN Plus. It gives you access to all the paid features on Proton Mail(new window), Proton VPN(new window), Proton Calendar(new window), Proton Drive(new window), Proton Pass, and Proton Wallet without requiring a separate subscription for each service.
